action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly handled certain WebSocket
frames. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause an
application to crash or expose sensitive information. This issue only
affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, and Ubuntu
26.10. (CVE-2026-12478)

It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly handled certain data URIs. A
remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause an application to
crash or expose sensitive information. This issue only affected Ubuntu
22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 26.10.
(CVE-2026-102555)

It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly handled certain WebSocket
messages. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause an
application to crash. This issue only affected Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu
20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, and
Ubuntu 26.10. (CVE-2026-102556)

It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly handled fragmented WebSocket
messages. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause an
application to crash. (CVE-2026-102557)

It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly handled certain WebSocket
frames. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause an
application to crash. This issue only affected Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu
20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, and
Ubuntu 26.10. (CVE-2026-102558)

It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly handled large WebSocket
messages. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause an
application to crash. (CVE-2026-102559)

It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly handled compressed WebSocket
messages. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause an
application to crash. This issue only affected Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu
22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 26.10.
(CVE-2026-102560)

It was discovered that libsoup did not properly handle certain HTTP
requests. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to inject
arbitrary HTTP requests. (CVE-2026-103399)

It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly handled proxy credentials. A
remote attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain sensitive
information. (CVE-2026-12547)

It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly handled multipart messages. A
remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause an application to
crash or obtain sensitive information. (CVE-2026-12548)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in libsoup.
title: libsoup vulnerabilities
